summary: Tested the auto_fix persistence bug fix, the ai_filter config on both bots, the AI loss-review SSE endpoint (hfx + bot scopes, with seeded data), the ai.ai_filter helper (real LLM + fail-closed), the live HFX bot AI-filter integration, and the UI on /analysis (Coach IA), /hfx-bot (Filtro IA switch), /bot (Filtro IA chip) and /chart/BTC-USD (regression). Backend: 16/16 pytest pass. Auto-fix bug is FIXED: verified by API and by the UI flow (toggle off on /analysis, save on /hfx-bot, auto_fix stays false, /analysis switch still off). The HFX bot with ai_filter on logged real 'ai' rejections ('IA rejeitou HFX PUT USD/CAD OTC: ...'). No approved entry was seen in about 5 minutes. The main-bot ai_filter path was only code-reviewed: /bot/run gave no signal. Coach IA streams progressively (0→155→...→1788 chars over ~10s). The text persists and reloads after a scope switch. Switching scope resets the card. Separately, I found and fixed a 500 on POST /api/auth/session: a DuplicateKeyError when the same session_token is inserted twice.

minor.issue: Returned 500 (pymongo DuplicateKeyError on user_sessions.session_token_1) when the same Emergent session is exchanged twice. Seen in backend.out.log. FIXED by testing agent: insert_one changed to update_one(upsert=True).

The AI call (up to 15s timeout, run one pair after another) happens AFTER the 'act only on the candle that just closed (<=20s)' check. A 1-minute option can therefore open up to ~35s late. With 8 pairs, AI calls can also take longer than the 60s loop and skip bars. Suggest running the filter calls for all pairs in parallel (asyncio.gather), re-checking freshness after the AI call, or using a shorter timeout (~6s) for HFX.

The prompt passes raw internal keys (fixes / ctx: trend_align, skip_low_vol, vol_pct, htf_aligned). The LLM echoes them to the user in backticks, e.g. 'trend_align=false, skip_low_vol=false'. It also once used '€10' although the app uses $. Suggest mapping keys to Portuguese labels in review_prompt and stating the currency.
The bot doc returns user_id. HFX GET pops it; the main bot GET does not.

ui_bugs.issue: When there are fewer than 3 trades, the backend's 400 'Poucas operações fechadas para a IA analisar (mínimo 3)' is lost. streamSSE throws a generic ApiError(res.status, 'Falha na análise IA') without reading the response body, so the user sees only 'Falha na análise IA'. Fix: on !res.ok, parse res.json().detail. Reference: /app/frontend/src/api.ts:66

issues: Coach IA 'Explicar perdas' button is active even with 0 operations; consider disabling it or showing a hint when trades < 3
Raw markdown backticks (`...`) appear in the AI text: MarkdownLite does not strip inline code (src/components/markdown.tsx)
The error toast renders at the top over the header title (overlaps 'Análise de Perdas')

The filter ChipRow (EMA200 / TF superior / ✨ Filtro IA) has no section label, unlike Estratégia/Timeframe. On 375px the Filtro IA chip sits at the right edge of a horizontal scroll and is easy to miss

action_items: streamSSE: surface the backend 'detail' on non-2xx (e.g. 'Poucas operações...') instead of the generic 'Falha na análise IA' (src/api.ts:66)
HFX ai_filter timing: run the AI checks in parallel or with a shorter timeout, and re-check bar freshness after the AI decision, so 1m entries are not late
review_prompt: translate fix/ctx keys into human Portuguese labels and state the $ currency; strip backticks in MarkdownLite
Optional: disable the Coach IA button or show a hint when the scope has fewer than 3 closed trades; add a section label for the filter chips on /bot
Pop user_id from the GET /api/bot response
critical_code_review_comments: ai.ai_filter fails closed correctly (verified with timeout=0.01 → approve False, 'IA indisponível...')

ai_filter adds one LLM call per signal; with a strict risk-manager prompt the AI rejected 2/2 observed signals ('estatística ainda fraca'). Users may see the bot almost never trade; consider showing an approval-rate stat
server.py is 1107 lines and hfx.py 866: both exceed 700 lines and should be split into modules

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows work; 1 medium UX bug (error message)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily seeded 6 TEST_ hfx_trades and 5 TEST_ bot positions; all removed. ai_reviews for user_test1 cleared (they were generated from fake data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Final state: HFX bot enabled=False, ai_filter=False, auto_fix=True, pairs=[EURUSD=X], min_winrate 56. Main bot enabled=False, ai_filter=False, auto_fix=True. Run test_iter7_ai_features.py (pytest.ini uses xdist; it passes in parallel). Use manual_seed_ai_review.py seed|clean [--reviews] for UI testing of Coach IA.
rca_of_issue: auth/session 500: Emergent can return the same session_token for repeated exchanges of one session_id (React double effect or a retry). insert_one then violated the unique index session_token_1. Mitigation applied: update_one(..., upsert=True).
